# Altruva Aesthetic & Regenerative Clinic

Altruva is a premier regenerative and aesthetic clinic based in Jakarta, Indonesia. Specializing in advanced, non-invasive procedures led by dr. Olivia Aldisa.

## Key Facts

- **Name:** Altruva Aesthetic Clinic (altruva.co.id)
- **Positioning:** Jakarta's 1st Regenerative Contouring Clinic — regenerative aesthetics combining skin/soft-tissue quality restoration with natural facial contouring.
- **Founded & Led By:** dr. Olivia Aldisa, dipl. AAAM — Aesthetic Doctor, Founder, Medical Director & Head Doctor; international Key Opinion Leader and trainer (e.g., CoolSculpting Medical Trainer, Allergan).
- **Credentials:** Doctor of Medicine (Universitas Padjadjaran), Master's in Business & Management (Universitas Pelita Harapan), Diploma in Aesthetic Medicine (American Academy of Aesthetic Medicine), plus international certifications (Merz, Galderma, IMCAS, AAAM).
- **Philosophy:** "Quiet Luxury" — natural, non-surgical, personalized, evidence-based treatments for aging gracefully and timeless beauty.
- **Focus:** Non-surgical profiloplasty, collagen biostimulation, energy-based devices (Sofwave, EmSculpt Neo, Exion), regenerative injectables (Gouri, Bio-PRF, exosomes/polynucleotides), skin quality optimization, and hair restoration; dedicated focus on women aged 40+.
- **Location:** Jl. Ciasem I No.2, Kebayoran Baru, Jakarta Selatan 12180, Indonesia.
- **Contact:** +62 812-1611-9392 · admin@altruva.co.id
- **Hours:** Tue–Sat 10:00–18:00, Sun 09:00–17:00, Mon closed.

## Technical Details

- **Technology Stack**: Next.js, React, Tailwind CSS, Radix UI primitives.
- **CMS Platform**: Secure custom admin panel for managing dynamic articles, keywords, metadata, and blog formatting.
- **Content Delivery**: Google Cloud Storage (GCS) for optimized medical imagery and responsive asset delivery.
